result.stderr:
usage: decisiondriven-report --assembly <file-or-directory> [--assembly ...] [--repo <dir>] [--ledger <dir>] [--since <ref>] [--out <dir>]
       decisiondriven-report --version

  --assembly  a built assembly, or a directory whose *.dll are read; repeat for more
  --repo      the repository root, for git history (default: the current directory)
  --ledger    the ledger directory, relative to the repository (default: docs/decisions)
  --since     a ref; decisions first cited after it are listed as newly cited
  --out       where report.md and citations.nt are written (default: artifacts/report)
